| 11-13 | Snapped Twig | A small noise escapes you despite your care. Nearby enemies become alert, though they may not know exactly where you are yet. | Low |  |

| 54-56 | Hidden No More | Your concealment fails at close range. The enemy sees you before you are ready to act. | High |  |
